description: Binary assertions for learn-methodology --source mode — teaching what a specific book says, with every book claim a verbatim «quote» machine-checked by scripts/quote_check.py. Static audit of SKILL.md + references/ because the protocol lives in references/source-mode.md. The script itself is covered by scripts/test_learn_quote_check.py.
test_input: giải thích đơn giản morphological matrix --source D:/Workshop_X/3_Resources/Books/pahl-beitz/_source

assertions.name: source_flag_declared
assertions.check: argument-hint advertises --source so the flag is discoverable at invocation

assertions.name: file_folder_notebook_accepted
assertions.check: --source accepts a file, a folder (book-to-learn _source/) and an NLM notebook id/alias

assertions.name: book_claims_are_verbatim_quotes
assertions.check: every 'the book says' line is a verbatim «quote» in the book's original language

assertions.name: numbers_only_inside_quotes
assertions.check: every number taken from the book must sit inside «…» — the script can only check what is quoted
assertions.regex: Every number taken from the book sits inside «…»

assertions.name: ai_invented_content_labelled
assertions.check: analogies, acronyms, diagnostic questions and examples the AI invents carry an [AI] label and do not borrow the book's authority

assertions.name: location_from_script_not_typed
assertions.check: the page/location comes from quote_check output, never typed by hand — a guessed page looks identical to a read one

assertions.name: silent_book_is_a_gap
assertions.check: when the book is silent the output records KHOẢNG TRỐNG instead of filling from general knowledge

assertions.name: try_spellings_before_gap
assertions.check: try at least 3 spellings/synonyms before declaring a gap — most misses are search misses

assertions.name: quote_check_is_the_gate
assertions.check: the output is written to a file and quote_check.py is run against the source, with explicit exit-code handling

assertions.name: unmeasurable_means_stop
assertions.check: exit 2 (unreadable/empty/scanned source) stops the run — never delivered as source-grounded

assertions.name: no_grounded_label_before_pass
assertions.check: the output may not be called source-grounded until the script exits 0

assertions.name: unfound_claim_deleted_not_paraphrased
assertions.check: a quote that cannot be found is deleted with its claim — not quietly downgraded to paraphrase
assertions.regex: không hạ nó thành Diễn giải

assertions.name: book_cluster_conflicts_not_merged
assertions.check: a book cluster gets a mandatory section placing conflicting quotes side by side, never merged into one voice
assertions.regex: Chỗ các nguồn khác nhau[\s\S]{0,200}(never merged|không gộp)

assertions.name: file_beats_notebook
assertions.check: when both a file and a notebook exist, verify against the file — NLM finds, the file is truth
assertions.regex: NLM là công cụ tìm, tệp là sự thật

assertions.name: no_custom_persona
assertions.check: forbids chat_configure with a custom goal because a persona silently disables source retrieval

assertions.name: one_conversation_per_question
assertions.check: each NLM question opens a fresh conversation — only the first query in a conversation is reliably grounded
assertions.regex: Mỗi câu hỏi một conversation mới

assertions.name: real_citation_does_not_prove_answer
assertions.check: a real citation does not prove the answer — check the answer content in the book, not only the quoted passage
assertions.regex: Trích dẫn đúng không chứng minh đáp án đúng

assertions.name: mnemonic_list_matches_book
assertions.check: MNEMONIC's list is copied from the book and its item count and order must match the book

assertions.name: diagnostic_answers_are_quotes
assertions.check: each FEYNMAN diagnostic question must be answerable by a quote from the book; questions the book cannot answer are dropped
assertions.regex: đáp án của mỗi câu là một trích dẫn

assertions.name: chunks_follow_book_structure
assertions.check: CHUNKING follows the book's own chapter structure rather than an AI-invented dependency graph
assertions.regex: Cụm đi theo \*\*cấu trúc của sách\*\*

assertions.name: gate_checks_words_not_meaning
assertions.check: states honestly that the script checks words, not meaning — a real quote next to a distorting paraphrase still passes
assertions.regex: Script bắt chữ, không bắt nghĩa

assertions.name: every_segment_checkable
assertions.check: each run between ellipses must be >= 2 words, so a fabricated number cannot hide between two real fragments
assertions.regex: mỗi đoạn giữa hai chỗ lược phải từ 2 từ trở lên

assertions.name: ladder_rung_is_a_gap
assertions.check: a rung is the gap to the next review, not a day number from creation; the absolute schedule is spelled out
